Class H3Flat2DRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.H3Flat2DRenderer
public class H3Flat2DRenderer extends Object
2D Equirectangular Flat Map Renderer for H3 hexagonal planetary grids.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to fulfill SRP and symmetrically separate 2D equirectangular viewport projection, binary latitude culling, cosine latitude stretching, and floating layer elevation shadows from 3D globe rendering.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
